source_caption_text:
Nothing like Dolph to start the day 😮‍💨🔥

Some songs just put you straight into get-money mode, and Young Dolph’s “Baller Alert” is one of them. Released in 2017 on his Gelato mixtape, the track has that bouncy production from Izze The Producer and Dolph’s unmistakable laid-back delivery. It’s the kind of song you throw on first thing in the morning when you’re ready to get out there and chase a bag.

Dolph spends the track talking about the money he’s made, the lifestyle he’s built and doing things on his own terms. He makes it clear that he isn’t waiting on a major label or anyone else’s approval, staying true to the independent hustle that made him who he was.

There’s something about Dolph’s music that makes you want to get up and get to work. “Baller Alert” is full of that confidence, and it still hits like the perfect soundtrack to a morning when you’ve got money on your mind.
